q: Input-output stability (BIBO: bounded input bounded output) for a linear system with transfer function G(s) holds if and only if:
opts: All poles of G(s) are in the open left half-plane (OLHP) and G(s) is proper
exp: BIBO stability ↔ the impulse response g(t) is absolutely integrable (∫₀^∞ |g(t)| dt < ∞) ↔ all poles of G(s) are in the open left half-plane. This is the standard condition for stability of linear time-invariant systems.
